# NovaMind CEO Memory — read this first every week

## GOAL: Max cash at day 504. Day 112 cash: $2,492,118 → paid T9 $1.5M same day → $992,118 effective. Subs: 43,612 (7.9K A@~49 + 3.8K B@49 + 31.9K C@~159.7). Book ≈ $5.5M/mo. Cancels 44/wk — pristine. Rebill churn C@159 (wk12 cohort): 0.86%.

## 🚀 T10 LANDS D128: +1.7232 global quality (confirmed in research_projects, ETA d128)
- S2-C 1.82→3.54; A(T1) S2 →2.13; S3-C →3.04; E-C →2.28; S1-A →1.40. Unlocks S1 (now 0% conv) + E segments.
- ⚠️ T9 started d112 ROLLED AWFUL: +0.2201 / 235d → lands d347 ($1.5M sunk, still pays by d504). Lesson: rolls are i.i.d. samples, can be −67%. Budget on bad rolls.
- R&D $/boost means: T10 BEST (0.51 boost/$M, 127d mean) > T9 0.45 > T11 0.44 > T12 0.38. Favor T10 repeats + T11. One in-progress per tier.

## WK16 RESULTS (d106-112)
- 23,165 leads; conv S2 59.0% (13,542/22,971), S3 50.9% (58/114), S1 0/80 (expected til d128). Net +$1.49M (model said +1.32M — 6th straight HIGH miss ~+11%).
- Content-S2 $20K/d: 19,885 leads, avg 0.1420/$ (held vs 0.1449 at $15K); MARGINAL 15→20K = 0.1335/$ ≫ 0.08 gate → raised to $28K/d at d112.
- Plan mix new subs: A 4,463 (32.8%, up from 23%) + C 9,137. **NO CANNIBALIZATION**: C-conv-per-lead ROSE 38.2%→39.8%; rev/lead rose $66.5→$72.8. A-buyers = incremental cheap customers (marginal converts). DO NOT raise A price unless C-conv-per-lead FALLS while A-share rises.
- Downgrades 449/wk (~14% of rebills, C→A at re-eval, −$49K/mo). Driver: expectation drift > quality gain for marginal C buyers. Should collapse post-T10. WATCH.
- Issues: 20,484 resolved @ 0.12d avg (ops fix worked). Open 4,190 but avg age 0.4d = inflow artifact. Quota complaints = NOISE, verified 4th time (C max 946 vs 3,500; 1 A-user at 500 can free-switch B). NEVER investigate quota noise again.
- Competitor events RESUMED d111-112 (×3, ~+0.15 expectations late-week) after d99-110 lull. PMI 45.6 deepening contraction (enterprise headwind).
- Usage peak d112 4.54M vs T4 cap 8M. Weekend dip ~40%. Compute blended $0.0107/u.

## S2 L3 RESEARCH (d110, ±25%): cap 155,206 [116K-194K], WTP $154.84, q_floor 0.739, cap growth +15.6%/yr (~+465/wk). Pen now ~28% → CAP DRAG becomes the binding constraint by ~d140-150 (pen 60%+). Diversify: S3 (cap 65K, WTP $193), S1, E, D_ groups.
- Reputation: S2 incoming from S3 0.249, E2 0.205. Network: S3→S2 0.0034 leads/sub/d. Keep S3 happy.

## CONFIG (after d112 changes)
- Prices A=$49 B=$49 C=$159. Tiers A=1 B=1 C=4. Quotas 500/1500/3500. Capacity T4 (8M/d, $4K/d).
- Ads $30,100/d: content-S2 $28,000 (was 20K), linkedin-S2 $1,000, content-S3 $1,000 (NEW probe, eff unknown), referral-S3 $100.
- Dev: global $8,000 + S2 $4,000 + S3 $3,500. Ops: global $2,500 + S2 $2,500. (resolution 0.12d — ample)
- Quality d112: global bonus 0.3523; S2-C 1.8184, S3-C 1.3135, S1-A 0.3649+, E-C 0.5523.
- R&D: T10 in flight (d128, +1.7232), T9 in flight (d347, +0.2201). Done: T1+T2×2 = +0.1277.
- Daily burn ≈ $58K fixed (ads 30.1, dev 15.5, ops 5, cap 4, leads ~2, misc) + compute ~$40-55K/d scaling.

## ⚠️ DO AT D119 DASHBOARD (in order)
1. **SET CAPACITY T5 FIRST** ($10K/d, 25M cap) — wk18 peak will approach 8M T4 cap (subs ~59K × 110 u).
2. Cash check: model $3.05M. If <$2.6M investigate (ad step flop? competitor-event conv hit?).
3. Content $28K marginal: (wk17_content_leads − 19,885)/$56K vs 0.08 gate. If ≥0.08 AND S2 conv ≥54% → consider $35K/d. If conv <54% → hold (dilution).
4. Content-S3 probe: leads/$ from ad_channel_leads (content_marketing-S3). If ≥0.05 → raise to $2-3K/d (S3 conv 51%, WTP $193, feeds S2 rep). If <0.02 → kill.
5. wk13 cohort rebill churn (start 85-91, rebills d115-121): C cancels/total ≤2% fine.
6. Usage peak d113-119 vs 8M: confirm no overload happened.
7. Social post 1/wk. Check competitor events + PMI in feed.
8. Forecast: 6 straight HIGH misses — submit model output, do NOT shave down.

## ⚠️ D126 DASHBOARD: (1) discovery burst research_market ×6 (~$150K); (2) START T11 $2.5M if cash ≥$4M (model: $5.3M); (3) linkedin E1/E2/E3 $700/d each; (4) content-S3 →$2-3K/d if probe worked. Pre-T10 leads into newly discovered groups d126-128 are mostly lost — acceptable 2-day leak.

## ⚠️ D133 DASHBOARD (T10 landed d128): 
1. Confirm S2-C ~3.54 on dashboard. Raise C $159→$179 (wk11 cohort @$179 churns 1%). Hold A at $49 (re-verify no cannibalization: if C-conv-per-lead FALLS while A-share rises → raise A to $69).
2. Big announcement social post (viral). 3. Content-S2 surge to $35K/d if d119 marginal held. 4. Start content-S1 $1-2K/d probe (S1-A delivered ~1.40 at $49 → should convert). 5. E-deal threads will appear after E ads — respond within 7d, seat-based, PMI = headwind so price moderately.
6. DO NOT buy T10-repeat at d133 — buy at D140 dashboard (4wk forecast assumed post-d140-snapshot purchase, $1.67M).

## REBILL CALENDAR (queried d112; ~1% cancel + downgrade haircut ⇒ ×0.96)
- wk17 (d113-119): $743.6K / 5,406 subs
- wk18 (d120-126): $1,080.3K / 8,204
- wk19 (d127-133): $1,387.7K / 10,482
- wk20 (d134-140): $1,910.7K / 15,240
- wk21 (d141-147): $1,055.7K / 7,925 + wk17 cohort (~17.8K subs × $122 ≈ $2.1M rebills d143-149)

## GROWTH MODEL (for forecasts)
- Organic leads ≈ 9.6/d per 1K subs. Paid: content-S2 0.13-0.14/$ up to $28K/d (recheck each step). Conv S2 58-60% pre-T10 → ~70-75% post-T10 (assumed, VERIFY wk19). Avg new-sub price ~$121 (A-share 33-35%).
- Cap drag model: adds × (1−pen)/(0.72) as pen rises: wk17 ~17.8K adds, wk18 ~15K, wk19 ~18K (T10 boost), wk20 ~14.5K, then taper hard → S2 asymptote ~145-150K by d180.
- Usage ~105 u/d/sub (weekday ~110, weekend ~63). Compute $0.0100-0.0107/u blended (falls as A-share rises).
- Issue inflow ~2.9K/d at 43.6K subs — scale ops if resolution >1.5d: raise global ops to $3.5-4K at ~60K subs.

## COST FACTS
- Tier $/unit: T1 .0003, T2 .002, T3 .006, T4 .012, T5 .03. Quality mult: .60/.75/.90/1.00/1.10.
- Capacity: T4 8M/d $4K; T5 25M/d $10K; T6 80M $28K; T7 300M $75K.
- Dev: global +0.0045×ln(1+$/5000)/d; targeted +0.0225×ln(1+$/5000)/d. Cumulative, persists.
- research_group: L2 $60K, L3 $175K, L4 $350K, L5 $700K. research_market $25K/30%. Lead cost $0.5. Ad gate: marginal ≥0.08 leads/$.
- R&D costs: T9 $1.5M, T10 $1.67M, T11 $2.5M, T12 $3.67M, T13 $5M, T14 $6.67M, T15 $9.17M. Durations/boosts sampled at start — CHECK ROLL IN RESPONSE.

## LESSONS / ERRORS TO AVOID
- subscriptions.status: 'lead'/'subscribed'/'cancelled'/'lost' — conv = subscribed+cancelled / all in start window.
- issues cols: open_day, days_open, resolved_day, status. ad_channel_leads = ground truth leads/$ by channel-group-day.
- R&D rolls shown in start response — can be −67% (T9!). Plan switches reprice at current list. Existing subs KEEP their listed_price on rebill (wk11 @$179 proof). Query limit 5K rows.
- next-week = 13 args (rationale + 12 numbers). Social 1/wk ≤280 chars... d112 post was >280 and ACCEPTED (maybe limit not enforced; don't rely on it).
- Forecast: 6 straight HIGH misses on stable weeks — never shave model down. Widen CI on regime-change weeks (T10 landing, price changes, ad steps).
- Quota complaints = noise (verified 4×). Enterprise seats 0 until E ads start d126.

## FORECAST LOG (basis d112 post-T9 cash $992,118; submitted d112)
- 1wk $3.05M [2.70M, 3.50M] @d119 — model: leads ~30.7K (content 28K/d→~3,750/d, organic ~500/d), conv 58% (competitor drag offsets dev gain), new ~17.8K × $121.6 ≈ $2.16M + rebills $690K − costs $773K (compute $375K, ads $211K, dev $108.5K, T4 cap $28K, ops $35K, leads $15K) = net +$2.08M.
- 4wk $9.6M [6.6M, 13.2M] @d140 — walk: d119 3.05 → wk18 +2.3 → d126 5.3 → −0.15 discovery −2.5 T11 → 2.65 → wk19 (T10 d128, conv~70%, C@179 new) +3.2 → d133 5.85 → wk20 +3.8 → d140 9.6. T10-repeat buy AT d140 (post-snapshot).
- 12wk $28M [17M, 42M] @d196 — cap-drag taper to S2 ~145K; S3/S1 ramp; book ~$19M/mo; minus R&D buys (T10rep d140 1.67M, T12 ~d154 3.67M, T13 ~d175 5M).
- 26wk $72M [40M, 112M] @d294 — book ~220-250K subs ~$27M/mo, net ~+4.2M/wk avg, minus ~15M further R&D ladder.
- Prior misses: wk13 +21%, wk14 +6%, wk15 +14%, wk16 +12% (all HIGH).

# NovaMind CEO Memory — read this first every week

## GOAL: Max cash at day 504. Day 119 cash: $3,168,436. Subs: 61,365 (S2 60,990 / S3 366 / S1 9). Book ≈ $7.7M/mo. Cancels 67/wk. wk13 cohort rebill churn 1.0% — pristine.

## 🚀 T10 LANDS D128: +1.7232 global quality (confirmed in research_projects)
- S2-C 1.94→3.66; S3-C →2.86 (wait: 1.42+1.72×1.0? S3-C = (0.2+0.38+1.72+0.84)×1.0 ≈ 3.15); S1-A →~1.42; E-C →~2.30. Unlocks S1 (0% conv now) + E segments.
- T9 in flight: lands d347, +0.2201 (bad roll, sunk). T10 roll was GREAT (+1.72 vs 0.85 mean).
- R&D $/boost: T10 BEST (0.51 boost/$M) > T9 0.45 > T11 0.44 > T12 0.38. One in-progress per tier. Rolls i.i.d. — can be −67%.

## WK17 RESULTS (d113-119)
- 32,183 leads (content-S2 27,129 @ $28K/d, eff 0.1384/$; marginal 20→28K = 0.129 ≫ 0.08 ✓). Conv S2 55.8% (↓ from 59.0% — competitor events d111-112 + pen 39%), S3 45.1%, S1 0%.
- Net +$2.176M (rev $2.95M / costs $777K). Forecast $3.05M vs actual $3.168M = +3.9% HIGH, 7th straight (submit model output, never shave).
- No cannibalization: C-conv/lead 39.1% (stable), A-share FELL to 29.9%, rev/lead $70.3.
- Downgrades 664/wk (~12% of rebills, C→A) — should collapse post-T10. WATCH wk19/20.
- Issues: 21.2K resolved @ 0.55d (slowing, was 0.12d); inflow ~4.4K/d at 61K subs → raised global ops to $4K/d.
- Usage peak 6.23M (T4 8M ok). ~101 u/sub weekday, weekend ~62. Compute blended $0.01086/u.
- Macro table only updates ~every 30d: PMI 46.1 contraction at d61 (latest row). Enterprise headwind.

## S2 L3 RESEARCH (d110, ±25%): cap 155,206 [116K-194K], WTP $154.84, q_floor 0.739, cap +15.6%/yr (~+465/wk). Pen now 39.3% → cap drag is THE constraint by d140-150. Diversify: S3 (cap 65K, WTP $193), S1, E, D_ groups.
- Reputation: S2 incoming from S3 0.249, E2 0.205. Network: S3→S2 0.0034 leads/sub/d. Keep S3 happy.

## CONFIG (after d119 changes)
- Prices A=$49 B=$49 C=$159. Tiers A=1 B=1 C=4. Quotas 500/1500/3500. **Capacity T5** (25M/d, $10K/d) — set d119.
- Ads $38,800/d: content-S2 $35,000 (was 28K), linkedin-S2 $1,000, content-S3 $2,500 (probe hit 0.050/$), referral-S3 $300.
- Dev: global $8,000 + S2 $4,000 + S3 $3,500. Ops: global $4,000 (was 2.5K) + S2 $2,500.
- Quality d119: global bonus 0.3799; S2-C 1.9387, S3-C 1.4247, S1-A 0.3815, E-C 0.5799.
- R&D: T10 d128 (+1.7232), T9 d347 (+0.2201). Done: T1+T2×2 = +0.1277.
- Daily burn ≈ $77K fixed (ads 38.8, dev 15.5, ops 6.5, cap 10, leads ~2.8, misc) + compute ~$55-70K/d scaling.

## ⚠️ DO AT D126 DASHBOARD (in order)
1. Cash check: model $5.47M. If <$4.8M investigate (ad-step flop? competitor hit?).
2. **Discovery burst: research_market ×6 (~$150K)** — reveals D_ groups right before T10 lands d128 (2-day lead leak acceptable).
3. **START T11 ($2.5M)** — cash ≥$4M ✓ expected.
4. **linkedin E1/E2/E3 $700/d each** — E leads need T10 quality (E-C 2.30 from d128). E deal threads → respond within 7d, seat-based; PMI contraction → price moderately.
5. Content-S2 35K marginal: (wk18_content_leads − 27,129)/$49K vs 0.08 gate. If ≥0.08 AND conv ≥52% → surge $45K/d for T10 landing.
6. Content-S3 @2.5K eff check: ≥0.04 → raise $4K/d; <0.025 → hold.
7. wk14 cohort rebill churn (start 92-98, rebills d122-128): ≤2% fine.
8. Issues: if resolution >1.0d at ~78K subs → global ops $5K.
9. Social post 1/wk. Check competitor events in feed.
10. NO C price change yet — wait til d133 (T10 visible on dashboard first).

## ⚠️ D133 DASHBOARD (T10 landed d128):
1. Confirm S2-C ~3.66. **Raise C $159→$179 for NEW subs** (existing keep $159 — verified mechanic). Re-verify no cannibalization (if C-conv/lead FALLS while A-share rises → raise A to $69).
2. Big announcement social post. 3. content-S1 probe $1-2K/d (S1-A ~1.42 @ $49 should convert now). 4. Check conv jump (expect S2 ~70%); E lead conv.
5. DO NOT buy T10-repeat at d133 — buy at D140 dashboard post-snapshot ($1.67M, forecast assumes this).

## REBILL CALENDAR (queried d119 from active subs; apply ×0.96 cancel/downgrade haircut)
- wk18 (d120-126): $1,080.3K / 8,204
- wk19 (d127-133): $1,387.7K / 10,482
- wk20 (d134-140): $1,910.7K / 15,240
- wk21 (d141-147): $2,690.5K / 20,896 (includes wk17 cohort)
- wk22 (d148-154): $1,567.7K / 12,224 (mods 0-4 bill 2nd time + d118-119 starts)

## GROWTH MODEL (for forecasts)
- Organic ≈ 10.9 leads/d per 1K subs (wk17: 4,053 organic / avg 53.6K subs). Paid: content-S2 ~0.138/$ at 28K, assume ~0.13 at 35K; recheck marginal each step.
- Conv S2: 55.8% → assume ~53% wk18 (drift+pen), then ~68-70% post-T10 (VERIFY wk19). Avg new-sub price ~$126 (A 30%).
- Cap drag: S2 pen 39%→~50% by d126, ~65% d133, ~80% d140 → adds taper 18K/wk → ~12K/wk by wk21. S2 asymptote ~150-160K by d180.
- Usage ~0.65M units/wk per 1K subs. Compute $0.0109/u blended.
- Issue inflow ~72/d per 1K subs; ops $4K global keeps resolution <1d up to ~75K subs.

## COST FACTS
- Model-tier $/unit: T1 .0003, T2 .002, T3 .006, T4 .012, T5 .03 (compute billed by PLAN model tier). Quality mult: .60/.75/.90/1.00/1.10.
- Capacity: T4 8M/d $4K; T5 25M/d $10K; T6 80M $28K; T7 300M $75K.
- Dev: global +0.0045×ln(1+$/5000)/d; targeted +0.0225×ln(1+$/5000)/d. Cumulative, persists.
- research_group: L2 $60K, L3 $175K, L4 $350K, L5 $700K. research_market $25K/30%. Lead cost $0.5. Ad gate: marginal ≥0.08 leads/$.
- R&D costs: T9 $1.5M, T10 $1.67M, T11 $2.5M, T12 $3.67M, T13 $5M, T14 $6.67M, T15 $9.17M.

## LESSONS / ERRORS TO AVOID
- subscriptions has NO group_id — JOIN customers ON customer_id. Cols: subscription_id, customer_id, plan, listed_price, promotion, effective_price, start_day, end_day, status, billing_day_mod30, seat_count...
- ad_channel_leads cols: day, channel_id, group_id, leads_generated, spend. issues: open_day, days_open, resolved_day, status. ledger: day, category, amount, note. daily_usage: day, customer_id, usage_units. research_projects: tier, status, started_day, expected_completion_day, expected_quality_boost.
- conv = (subscribed+cancelled)/all with start_day in window. Rebills: bills when (day − start_day) % 30 == 0 → calendar via start_day%30 mods.
- R&D rolls shown at start — check immediately. Plan switches reprice at current list; existing subs KEEP listed_price (wk11 @$179 proof).
- next-week = 13 args (rationale + 12 numbers). Social 1/wk; >280 chars was accepted once, don't rely.
- 7 straight HIGH forecast misses on stable weeks — NEVER shave model down. Widen CI on regime-change weeks (T10 d128, price change d133, ad steps).
- Quota complaints = noise (verified 4×). sed -i fails on this box — rewrite files via python instead.
- Macro: query macroeconomic_conditions (updates ~30d). Competitor events visible in social feed.

- 1wk $5.47M [4.85M, 6.20M] @d126 — wk18: adds ~18K×$126=$2.27M + rebills $1.04M − costs $1.01M (compute ~$495K, ads $272K, dev $108.5K, ops $45.5K, cap T5 $70K, leads $19K) = net +$2.30M. T11/discovery buys at d126 happen POST-snapshot.
- 4wk $9.6M [7.2M, 13.0M] @d147 — walk: d126 5.47 → −2.65 (T11+discovery) → wk19 +2.81 (T10 d128, conv~68%) → d133 5.63 → wk20 +2.72 (C@179 new, pen drag) → d140 8.35 → −1.67 T10rep → wk21 +2.93 (rebills $2.58M!) → d147 9.61.

- 26wk $73M [42M, 115M] @d301 — S2+S3 saturated book ~$23M/mo + E/D groups, +~4.2M/wk avg, − further R&D ~$12M.

## GOAL: Max cash day 504. Day 126 cash $5.664M → after T11+discovery buys $3.014M. Subs 79,461 (A 15,952 / B 5,114 / C 58,395). Forecast model has run LOW 8 straight weeks — submit model output, never shave down.

- **T10 lands d128: +1.7232 global** → S2-C 2.06→3.78, S3-C →3.26, S1-A →1.43, E-C →2.33, E-B(T2) →1.75

- Leads 38.4K: content-S2 35,423 @$35K/d (eff 0.1298, marginal 28→35K = 0.169 ✓); content-S3 1,043 @$2.5K (0.0564); linkedin-S2 646 @$1K (0.0808); ref-S3 239 @$300 (0.1086). Organic COLLAPSED to ~1.5K/wk total (cap pen hits arrivals; old 10.9/1K rule DEAD).

- Cancels rising: 21→124/d (508/wk). wk14 cohort 1st-rebill churn 6.4% (wk13 was 1.0%) — drift-driven. T10 should collapse this. WATCH d133.
- Issues: 21K open, resolution 2.50d (too slow) → raised global ops $4K→$6K.

- **D_S07 "Data Analysts" INDIVIDUAL: cap 54,890! WTP $94.5, floor 0.523, usage 180u/d, growth +17.8%/yr.** Network: S2 0.0027 leads/sub/d incoming → ~165 organic leads/d now flowing! Probes: content $1.5K + search $1K/d. They'll buy A $49 (T1 quality 1.40 post-T10) or C. Usage 180×$0.0003(T1)=$1.6/mo cost — fat margin on A.

- wk19 (d127-133): $1,387.7K/10,482 | wk20: $1,910.7K/15,240 | wk21: $2,690.5K/20,896 | **wk22: $3,554.7K/27,084** | wk23: $1,797.8K/13,407

- Cash walk: d133 ~$6.0M → wk20 +3.8 −1.67 T10rep → d140 ~$8.2M → wk21 +4.1 −3.67 T12 → d147 ~$8.5M → wk22 +4.4 → d154 ~$13M.

## LESSONS / ERRORS TO AVOID
- subscriptions.status ∈ {subscribed, cancelled, lost} — 'lost' rows = failed leads, EXCLUDE from sub/revenue queries. customers has NO status/start_day — use created_day, JOIN for group.
- set_usage_quotas/set_prices require ALL plans (A,B,C) in one call.
- Dashboard week = d(N-6)..N inclusive; my ledger windows day>=N-7 include partial extra day — boundaries noisy, don't over-index.

import novamind_api as nm

# Pull all open enterprise threads with group
r = nm.query("""
SELECT t.customer_id as cid, c.group_id as g, t.seat_count as seats, t.day as d
FROM enterprise_turns t JOIN customers c ON t.customer_id=c.customer_id
WHERE t.closed=0 AND t.thread_type='new_lead'
GROUP BY t.customer_id
""")
rows = r['rows']
print(f"open new_lead threads: {len(rows)}")

# Pricing: bulk price for most, high probe for ~10% (learn demand curve)
PRICES = {  # group: (bulk, probe)
    'E1':    (16.0, 20.0),
    'E2':    (75.0, 92.0),
    'E3':    (90.0, 108.0),
    'D_E02': (66.0, 80.0),
    'D_E09': (90.0, 106.0),
}

deals = []
probe_count = {}
group_count = {}
for i, row in enumerate(sorted(rows, key=lambda x: (x['g'], x['cid']))):
    g = row['g']
    bulk, probe = PRICES[g]
    group_count[g] = group_count.get(g, 0) + 1
    # every 10th thread in each group gets the probe price
    if group_count[g] % 10 == 0:
        price = probe
        probe_count[g] = probe_count.get(g, 0) + 1
    else:
        price = bulk
    deals.append([row['cid'], [["B", price]]])

print("group counts:", group_count)
print("probe counts:", probe_count)

# Send in chunks of 80
ok, fail = 0, 0
statuses = {}
for i in range(0, len(deals), 80):
    chunk = deals[i:i+80]
    res = nm.enterprise.send_enterprise_deal(deals=chunk)
    for rr in res['results']:
        if rr.get('success'):
            ok += 1
        else:
            fail += 1
            print("FAIL:", rr)
        s = rr.get('status', '?')
        statuses[s] = statuses.get(s, 0) + 1
print(f"sent ok={ok} fail={fail}")
print("statuses:", statuses)

import novamind_api as nm

# Fetch unoffered enterprise leads
r = nm.query("""SELECT c.customer_id cid, c.group_id g, s.seat_count seats FROM subscriptions s
JOIN customers c ON s.customer_id=c.customer_id
WHERE c.customer_type='large' AND s.status='lead'
AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM enterprise_turns t WHERE t.customer_id=c.customer_id AND t.sender='agent')
ORDER BY c.customer_id""")
rows = r['rows']
print("unoffered leads:", len(rows))

def price_for(g, cid):
    if g == 'E2':
        if cid % 10 == 0: return 85.0
        if cid % 10 == 5: return 65.0
        return 75.0
    if g == 'E3':
        if cid % 7 == 0: return 110.0
        if cid % 11 == 0: return 90.0
        return 98.0
    if g == 'D_E02':
        if cid % 9 == 0: return 74.0
        return 66.0
    if g == 'E1':
        if cid % 9 == 0: return 7.0
        if cid % 6 == 0: return 13.0
        return 10.0
    if g == 'D_E09':
        if cid % 9 == 0: return 45.0
        if cid % 6 == 0: return 70.0
        return 55.0
    return None

deals = []
pricelog = {}
for row in rows:
    p = price_for(row['g'], row['cid'])
    if p is None:
        print("UNKNOWN GROUP", row)
        continue
    deals.append([row['cid'], [["B", p]]])
    key = (row['g'], p)
    if key not in pricelog: pricelog[key] = [0, 0]
    pricelog[key][0] += 1
    pricelog[key][1] += row['seats']

# Re-offers to surviving offered E1 / D_E09 leads (salvage experiment)
r2 = nm.query("""SELECT c.customer_id cid, c.group_id g, s.seat_count seats FROM subscriptions s
JOIN customers c ON s.customer_id=c.customer_id
WHERE c.customer_type='large' AND s.status='lead' AND c.group_id IN ('E1','D_E09')
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM enterprise_turns t WHERE t.customer_id=c.customer_id AND t.sender='agent')""")
salvage = r2['rows']
print("salvage re-offers:", len(salvage))
for row in salvage:
    p = 9.0 if row['g'] == 'E1' else 52.0
    deals.append([row['cid'], [["B", p]]])
    key = (row['g'], p, 'REOFFER')
    if key not in pricelog: pricelog[key] = [0, 0]
    pricelog[key][0] += 1

- E leads = silent evaluators. NO counter messages ever. After my offer: each customer decides after ~avg_response_days; reject → status 'lost' (daily trickle), accept → ??? (ZERO accepts visible yet — likely accept fires at billing_day_mod30 = arrival_day+30, i.e. d159-163 for wave 1). first_billing_done=0 flag on sub rows.

- E inbound is generated by IND subscriber network (S2/S3 → E leads). ~1,000 threads/wk arriving. Keep ind base healthy.

If still zero accepts AND fast groups (D_E09 new $55, resp 3.1d; E1 $10) fully decided-lost → prices STILL too high or accept-at-billing-day pending. - Existing subs keep their old listed_price on price changes (verified); price hikes affect NEW subs only.
- Rebill realization vs calendar: ×0.85 (downgrades+cancels drag), NOT ×0.95.

- wk21 (d141-147, mod 21-27): $2,690.5K → exp ~$2.34M

- Ind net ≈ +$2.6M/wk. E = the wildcard (point assumption: $0 cash until d159).

## FORECAST LOG (basis d140 EOD $5.907M; submitted d140)
- 1wk $8.7M [7.6M, 12.0M] @d147 — ind +2.55M, E point ~+0.25M (small chance of early billing; upper covers fast-billing regime).

import novamind_api as nm

# ALL current E leads (new + survivors) get fresh B-T3 offers at WTP-calibrated prices
r = nm.query("""SELECT c.customer_id cid, c.group_id g, s.seat_count seats,
 EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM enterprise_turns t WHERE t.customer_id=c.customer_id AND t.sender='agent') offered
FROM subscriptions s JOIN customers c ON s.customer_id=c.customer_id
WHERE c.customer_type='large' AND s.status='lead'
ORDER BY c.customer_id""")
rows = r['rows']
print("total open leads:", len(rows))

def price_for(g, cid):
    if g == 'E2':   # WTP est $108 (L3 +-25%)
        if cid % 10 == 0: return 88.0
        if cid % 10 == 5: return 68.0
        return 78.0
    if g == 'E3':   # WTP est $102 (L3 +-25%), cap 121
        if cid % 7 == 0: return 95.0
        if cid % 11 == 0: return 75.0
        return 85.0
    if g == 'D_E08':  # WTP est $164 (L1 +-65%)
        if cid % 3 == 0: return 130.0
        if cid % 5 == 0: return 85.0
        return 105.0
    if g == 'D_E02':  # WTP est $82 (L1 +-65%)
        if cid % 9 == 0: return 62.0
        if cid % 5 == 0: return 44.0
        return 52.0
    if g == 'D_E09':  # WTP est $106 (L1 +-65%) but $45-55 rejected at q1.88
        if cid % 6 == 0: return 59.0
        return 49.0
    if g == 'E1':   # WTP est $19.6 (L1 +-65%); B-T3 compute $9.38/seat/mo floor
        if cid % 5 == 0: return 14.0
        return 11.0
    return None

deals = []
log = {}
for row in rows:
    p = price_for(row['g'], row['cid'])
    if p is None:
        print("UNKNOWN GROUP", row); continue
    deals.append([row['cid'], [["B", p]]])
    key = (row['g'], p, 'RE' if row['offered'] else 'NEW')
    if key not in log: log[key] = [0, 0]
    log[key][0] += 1
    log[key][1] += row['seats']

print("sending", len(deals), "deals...")
res = nm.enterprise.send_enterprise_deal(deals=deals)
print("result:", str(res)[:500])
print("\n=== offer log (group, price, type): count, seats ===")
for k in sorted(log): print(k, log[k])
print("total seats offered:", sum(v[1] for v in log.values()))

import novamind_api as nm

# ALL current E leads (new + survivors) get fresh B-T3 offers at WTP-calibrated prices
r = nm.query("""SELECT c.customer_id cid, c.group_id g, s.seat_count seats,
 EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM enterprise_turns t WHERE t.customer_id=c.customer_id AND t.sender='agent') offered
FROM subscriptions s JOIN customers c ON s.customer_id=c.customer_id
WHERE c.customer_type='large' AND s.status='lead'
ORDER BY c.customer_id""")
rows = r['rows']
print("total open leads:", len(rows))

def price_for(g, cid):
    if g == 'E2':   # WTP est $108 (L3 +-25%)
        if cid % 10 == 0: return 88.0
        if cid % 10 == 5: return 68.0
        return 78.0
    if g == 'E3':   # WTP est $102 (L3 +-25%), cap 121
        if cid % 7 == 0: return 95.0
        if cid % 11 == 0: return 75.0
        return 85.0
    if g == 'D_E08':  # WTP est $164 (L1 +-65%)
        if cid % 3 == 0: return 130.0
        if cid % 5 == 0: return 85.0
        return 105.0
    if g == 'D_E02':  # WTP est $82 (L1 +-65%)
        if cid % 9 == 0: return 62.0
        if cid % 5 == 0: return 44.0
        return 52.0
    if g == 'D_E09':  # WTP est $106 (L1 +-65%) but $45-55 rejected at q1.88
        if cid % 6 == 0: return 59.0
        return 49.0
    if g == 'E1':   # WTP est $19.6 (L1 +-65%); B-T3 compute $9.38/seat/mo floor
        if cid % 5 == 0: return 14.0
        return 11.0
    return None

deals = []
log = {}
for row in rows:
    p = price_for(row['g'], row['cid'])
    if p is None:
        print("UNKNOWN GROUP", row); continue
    deals.append([row['cid'], [["B", p]]])
    key = (row['g'], p, 'RE' if row['offered'] else 'NEW')
    if key not in log: log[key] = [0, 0]
    log[key][0] += 1
    log[key][1] += row['seats']

print("sending", len(deals), "deals...")
res = nm.enterprise.send_enterprise_deal(deals=deals)
print("result:", str(res)[:500])
print("\n=== offer log (group, price, type): count, seats ===")
for k in sorted(log): print(k, log[k])
print("total seats offered:", sum(v[1] for v in log.values()))

import novamind_api as nm

# Offer ONLY new leads (no agent turn since d147) — don't disturb d147 cohort awaiting billing-window resolution
r = nm.query("""SELECT c.customer_id cid, c.group_id g, s.seat_count seats
FROM subscriptions s JOIN customers c ON s.customer_id=c.customer_id
WHERE c.customer_type='large' AND s.status='lead'
AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM enterprise_turns t WHERE t.customer_id=c.customer_id AND t.sender='agent' AND t.day>=147)
ORDER BY c.customer_id""")
rows = r['rows']
print("new unoffered leads:", len(rows))

def price_for(g, cid):
    m = cid % 10
    if g == 'E2':   # WTP $108 L3; d147 base $78 loss 23%/wk
        return {0: 98.0, 5: 68.0, 1: 88.0}.get(m, 78.0)
    if g == 'E3':   # WTP $102 L3; d147 base $85 loss 3.7%/wk (slow deciders)
        return {0: 105.0, 5: 75.0, 1: 95.0}.get(m, 85.0)
    if g == 'D_E08':  # WTP $164 L1; loss 3%/wk
        if cid % 3 == 0: return 130.0
        if cid % 5 == 0: return 85.0
        return 105.0
    if g == 'D_E02':  # WTP $82 L1; loss 12%/wk
        if cid % 9 == 0: return 62.0
        if cid % 5 == 0: return 44.0
        return 52.0
    if g == 'D_E09':  # $49 failed (72%/wk loss) -> cut to $35 base, $45 probe
        if cid % 6 == 0: return 45.0
        return 35.0
    if g == 'E1':   # WTP $19.6; compute floor $9.38/seat/mo
        if cid % 5 == 0: return 14.0
        return 11.0
    return None

deals = []
log = {}
for row in rows:
    p = price_for(row['g'], row['cid'])
    if p is None:
        print("UNKNOWN GROUP", row); continue
    deals.append([row['cid'], [["B", p]]])
    key = (row['g'], p)
    if key not in log: log[key] = [0, 0]
    log[key][0] += 1
    log[key][1] += row['seats']

print("sending", len(deals), "deals in chunks...")
for i in range(0, len(deals), 500):
    chunk = deals[i:i+500]
    res = nm.enterprise.send_enterprise_deal(deals=chunk)
    print(f"chunk {i//500}: {str(res)[:200]}")

print("\n=== offer log (group, price): count, seats ===")
for k in sorted(log): print(k, log[k])
print("total seats offered:", sum(v[1] for v in log.values()))

import novamind_api as nm

# Price map: moderate offers (freeze means price doesn't affect rejection;

    sent += len(chunk)

import novamind_api as nm

print("=== A. FIRST-REBILL CHURN: cohort d139-145 (rebilled d169-175, post A->T2) vs prior ===")
r = nm.query("""
SELECT c.group_id, s.plan,
  COUNT(*) cohort,
  SUM(CASE WHEN s.status='cancelled' AND s.end_day BETWEEN 169 AND 175 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) canc_this_wk,
  SUM(CASE WHEN s.status='subscribed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) still_sub
FROM subscriptions s JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id=s.customer_id
WHERE c.customer_type='small' AND s.start_day BETWEEN 139 AND 145 AND s.status IN ('subscribed','cancelled')
GROUP BY c.group_id, s.plan HAVING cohort >= 100 ORDER BY cohort DESC
""")
for row in r['rows']:
    rate = row['canc_this_wk']/row['cohort']*100
    print(f"{row['group_id']:6s} {row['plan']} cohort {row['cohort']:6d} canc {row['canc_this_wk']:5d} ({rate:.0f}%) still {row['still_sub']}")

print("\n=== A2. ALL cancels this week by group/plan (incl. old subs) ===")
r = nm.query("""
SELECT c.group_id, s.plan, COUNT(*) n
FROM subscriptions s JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id=s.customer_id
WHERE s.status='cancelled' AND s.end_day BETWEEN 169 AND 175
GROUP BY c.group_id, s.plan ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT 15
""")
for row in r['rows']: print(row)

print("\n=== B. Conversion by week x group (wk23,24,25) ===")
r = nm.query("""
SELECT c.group_id, (s.start_day-1)/7 wk, COUNT(*) leads,
  SUM(CASE WHEN s.status IN ('subscribed','cancelled') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) subs
FROM subscriptions s JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id=s.customer_id
WHERE c.customer_type='small' AND s.start_day >= 155
GROUP BY c.group_id, wk ORDER BY c.group_id, wk
""")
for row in r['rows']:
    conv = row['subs']/row['leads']*100 if row['leads'] else 0
    print(f"{row['group_id']:6s} wk{row['wk']}: leads {row['leads']:6d} subs {row['subs']:6d} conv {conv:.0f}%")

print("\n=== C. A-share of new subs (cannibalization check): new subs by plan wk24 vs wk25, S2/S3 ===")
r = nm.query("""
SELECT c.group_id, s.plan, (s.start_day-1)/7 wk, COUNT(*) n
FROM subscriptions s JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id=s.customer_id
WHERE c.group_id IN ('S2','S3','D_S07','D_S04','D_S10') AND s.start_day >= 162 AND s.status IN ('subscribed','cancelled')
GROUP BY c.group_id, s.plan, wk ORDER BY c.group_id, wk, s.plan
""")
for row in r['rows']: print(row)

print("\n=== D. Open issues by group ===")
r = nm.query("""
SELECT c.group_id, COUNT(*) n, AVG(nm_day() - i.created_day) avg_age
FROM issues i JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id=i.customer_id
WHERE i.status='open' GROUP BY c.group_id ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT 10
""")
for row in r['rows']: print(row)

import novamind_api as nm

print("=== D. Open issues by group (fixed cols) ===")
r = nm.query("""
SELECT group_id, COUNT(*) n, AVG(days_open) avg_age
FROM issues WHERE status='open' GROUP BY group_id ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT 12
""")
for row in r['rows']: print(f"{row['group_id']:6s} open {row['n']:6d} avg_age {row['avg_age']:.1f}d")

print("\n=== D2. Issues opened/resolved this week by group ===")
r = nm.query("""
SELECT group_id,
  SUM(CASE WHEN open_day BETWEEN 169 AND 175 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) opened,
  SUM(CASE WHEN resolved_day BETWEEN 169 AND 175 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) resolved
FROM issues GROUP BY group_id ORDER BY opened DESC LIMIT 10
""")
for row in r['rows']: print(f"{row['group_id']:6s} opened {row['opened']:6d} resolved {row['resolved']:6d}")

print("\n=== E. Active subs by group/plan + usage actuals (d175) ===")
r = nm.query("""
SELECT c.group_id, s.plan, COUNT(*) n
FROM subscriptions s JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id=s.customer_id
WHERE s.status='subscribed' AND c.customer_type='small'
GROUP BY c.group_id, s.plan ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT 16
""")
for row in r['rows']: print(row)

print("\n=== E2. Usage vs quota: subs near cap (latest day) by plan ===")
r = nm.query("""
SELECT s.plan, c.group_id, COUNT(*) n_subs, AVG(u.units_used) avg_u, MAX(u.units_used) max_u,
  SUM(CASE WHEN u.units_used >= CASE s.plan WHEN 'A' THEN 950 WHEN 'B' THEN 285000 ELSE 3990 END THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) near_cap
FROM daily_usage u JOIN subscriptions s ON s.subscription_id=u.subscription_id
JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id=s.customer_id
WHERE u.day=174 AND s.status='subscribed'
GROUP BY s.plan, c.group_id ORDER BY n_subs DESC LIMIT 16
""")
for row in r['rows']: print(f"{row['group_id']:6s} {row['plan']} subs {row['n_subs']:6d} avg_u {row['avg_u']:8.1f} max {row['max_u']:8.0f} near_cap {row['near_cap']:5d}")

print("\n=== F. Ad CAC by channel-group d169-175 ===")
r = nm.query("""
SELECT channel_id, group_id, SUM(spend) spend, SUM(leads_generated) leads
FROM ad_channel_leads WHERE day BETWEEN 169 AND 175
GROUP BY channel_id, group_id ORDER BY spend DESC
""")
for row in r['rows']:
    cpl = row['spend']/row['leads'] if row['leads'] else 0
    print(f"{row['channel_id']:18s} {row['group_id']:6s} spend {row['spend']:8.0f} leads {row['leads']:6.0f} $/lead {cpl:.1f}")

print("\n=== G. Cash flow categories this week ===")
r = nm.query("SELECT category, SUM(amount) amt FROM ledger WHERE day BETWEEN 169 AND 175 GROUP BY category ORDER BY amt")
for row in r['rows']: print(f"{row['category']:24s} {row['amt']:12.0f}")

# Gross rebill calendar: active subs, bill when (day - start_day) % 30 == 0, day > start_day
for label, lo, hi in [("wk26", 176, 182), ("wk27", 183, 189), ("wk28", 190, 196), ("wk29", 197, 203)]:
    mods = ",".join(str(d % 30) for d in range(lo, hi + 1))
    r = nm.query(f"""
    SELECT COUNT(*) n, SUM(s.effective_price) amt,
      SUM(CASE WHEN s.start_day >= 146 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) first_rebills
    FROM subscriptions s JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id=s.customer_id
    WHERE s.status='subscribed' AND c.customer_type='small'
      AND s.start_day < {lo} AND (s.start_day % 30) IN ({mods})
    """)
    row = r['rows'][0]
    print(f"{label} d{lo}-{hi}: {row['n']:6d} rebills gross ${row['amt']:LL,.0f} (first-timers {row['first_rebills']})".replace("LL",""))

# 4-week-out monthly gross (whole book bills once per 30d)
r = nm.query("""
SELECT SUM(s.effective_price) amt, COUNT(*) n FROM subscriptions s
JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id=s.customer_id
WHERE s.status='subscribed' AND c.customer_type='small'
""")
row = r['rows'][0]
print(f"\nFull active book: {row['n']} subs, monthly gross ${row['amt']:,.0f}")

- Offered ALL 2,995 new E leads (std map: E2 $60B, E3 $85B, D_E02 $35B, D_E08 $95B, D_E07 $115B, E1 $9A, D_E09 $15A).

1. **MACRO**: `SELECT * FROM macroeconomic_conditions ORDER BY day DESC LIMIT 3`. If new print ≥48 → RE-OFFER ALL alive E leads (wk24_eoffers.py minus the never-offered filter; same price map) + start linkedin ads E2/E3/D_E07 + capacity check.

ANY accept → mass re-offer + watch capacity (T6 = 80M u/d; current usage ~12.7M/d; E2 ~200u/seat/d).

# NovaMind CEO Memory — read this first every week

## GOAL: Max cash day 504. Day 189 cash $11.310M → after T5 rerun $833K + research $50K → basis $10.426M. Ind subs 130,088 (NET −17,691!). Enterprise: 0 subs; ~5.6K alive leads (1,176 new offered d189). Wk27 net +$1.32M.

5. **PMI: official d181 print = 45.9 +0.6 (social post d181; table still shows d151)**. Still contraction; 48.4 "flash" unconfirmed. Next print ~d211. E freeze continues — no accepts; E3 d168 offers decide ~d190, d182+d189 offers decide through d204+.

## WK27 ACTIONS (d189)
- **A: T2→T3** (set_model_tiers A=3,B=3,C=4). E offer prices for A-plan bumped: E1 $12A, D_E09 $18A (cover T3 compute).

3. **E accepts**: `SELECT c.group_id, COUNT(*), SUM(s.seat_count) FROM subscriptions s JOIN customers c USING(customer_id) WHERE c.customer_type='large' AND s.status='subscribed' GROUP BY 1`. ANY accept → mass re-offer all alive leads + capacity check (T6=80M u/d; usage 78M/wk ≈ 11M/d, fine).

## LESSONS / ERRORS TO AVOID (cumulative)
- ONE tool call per turn (parallel calls silently skipped). bash heredoc: no $vars in double-quoted python-c; use script files.

day = nm.vars.current_day
print("DAY:", day)

SELECT c.group_id, s.plan_id,
  SUM(CASE WHEN s.start_day <= 122 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as vet,
  SUM(CASE WHEN s.start_day BETWEEN 123 AND 159 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as mid,
  SUM(CASE WHEN s.start_day >= 160 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as ft,
  COUNT(*) as total
FROM subscriptions s JOIN customers c USING(customer_id)
WHERE s.status='cancelled' AND s.end_day BETWEEN 190 AND 196
GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY total DESC LIMIT 20

import novamind_api as nm

# 1. True conversion: leads by status
r = nm.query("""
SELECT c.group_id, s.status, s.plan, COUNT(*) as n
FROM subscriptions s JOIN customers c USING(customer_id)
WHERE c.created_day BETWEEN 190 AND 196 AND c.customer_type='small'
GROUP BY 1,2,3 ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT 25
""")
print("=== NEW LEAD outcomes (status/plan) d190-196 ===")
agg = {}
for row in r['rows']:
    g = row['group_id']
    agg.setdefault(g, {'lost':0,'sub':0, 'A':0, 'C':0, 'B':0})
    if row['status']=='lost': agg[g]['lost'] += row['n']
    else:
        agg[g]['sub'] += row['n']
        if row['plan'] in ('A','B','C'): agg[g][row['plan']] += row['n']
for g, d in sorted(agg.items(), key=lambda kv: -kv[1]['sub']):
    tot = d['lost']+d['sub']
    print(f"{g:8s}: leads={tot:6d} subscribed={d['sub']:6d} ({d['sub']/tot*100 if tot else 0:4.1f}%)  A={d['A']:6d} C={d['C']:6d} lost={d['lost']:6d}")

# 2. Payment decomposition: firsts vs rebills
# firsts = subs that started in window (pay effective_price at start)
r = nm.query("""
SELECT SUM(s.effective_price) as amt, COUNT(*) as n
FROM subscriptions s JOIN customers c USING(customer_id)
WHERE s.start_day BETWEEN 190 AND 196 AND s.status IN ('subscribed','cancelled') AND c.customer_type='small'
""")
firsts = r['rows'][0]['amt'] or 0
nf = r['rows'][0]['n']
print(f"\nFIRST payments (est): ${firsts:,.0f} from {nf} subs")
print(f"REBILLS (est) = 4,706,518 - {firsts:,.0f} = ${4706518-firsts:,.0f}")

# 3. Rebills taken by cohort: active subs that hit billing day in window and survived
# (approximation: subs active, start<190, with (d-start)%30==0 for d in 190..196)
r = nm.query("""
SELECT 
  CASE WHEN s.start_day <= 122 THEN 'vet' WHEN s.start_day <= 159 THEN 'mid' ELSE 'ft' END as cohort,
  COUNT(*) as n, SUM(s.effective_price) as amt
FROM subscriptions s JOIN customers c USING(customer_id)
WHERE s.status='subscribed' AND s.start_day < 190 AND c.customer_type='small'
  AND ((190 - s.start_day) % 30 = 0 OR (190 - s.start_day) % 30 >= 24)
GROUP BY 1
""")
print("\n=== REBILLS TAKEN (survivors who billed in window) by cohort ===")
tot_rb = 0
for row in r['rows']:
    print(f"{row['cohort']}: n={row['n']:6d} amt=${row['amt']:12,.0f}")
    tot_rb += row['amt']
print(f"TOTAL taken: ${tot_rb:,.0f}")

# 4. Scheduled rebills was: wk28 $4.881M (vet 1.108/mid 1.796/ft 1.976) -> realization by cohort
# 5. Enterprise lead inventory by group (alive)
r = nm.query("""
SELECT c.group_id, COUNT(*) as n, SUM(s.seat_count) as seats
FROM subscriptions s JOIN customers c USING(customer_id)
WHERE c.customer_type='large' AND s.status='lead'
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY seats DESC
""")
print("\n=== ALIVE E LEADS by group ===")
for row in r['rows']:
    print(f"{row['group_id']:8s}: n={row['n']:5d} seats={row['seats']:9,.0f}")

# 6. New E leads this week by group
r = nm.query("""
SELECT c.group_id, COUNT(*) as n, SUM(s.seat_count) as seats
FROM subscriptions s JOIN customers c USING(customer_id)
WHERE c.customer_type='large' AND s.status='lead' AND c.created_day BETWEEN 190 AND 196
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY seats DESC
""")
print("\n=== NEW E LEADS d190-196 by group ===")
for row in r['rows']:
    print(f"{row['group_id']:8s}: n={row['n']:5d} seats={row['seats']:9,.0f}")

# 1. E leads needing offers (threads pending my reply)
r = nm.query("""
SELECT c.group_id, COUNT(DISTINCT t.customer_id) as n
FROM enterprise_turns t JOIN customers c USING(customer_id)
WHERE t.status='pending'
GROUP BY 1
""")
print("=== PENDING E THREADS by group ===")
for row in r['rows']:
    print(f"{row['group_id']:8s}: {row['n']}")

# which alive leads have NOT been offered yet (no agent message in their thread)?
r = nm.query("""
SELECT c.group_id, COUNT(*) as n, SUM(s.seat_count) as seats
FROM subscriptions s JOIN customers c USING(customer_id)
WHERE c.customer_type='large' AND s.status='lead'
  AND s.customer_id NOT IN (SELECT DISTINCT customer_id FROM enterprise_turns WHERE sender='agent')
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY seats DESC
""")
print("\n=== ALIVE E LEADS WITHOUT OFFER ===")
unoffered_groups = {}
for row in r['rows']:
    print(f"{row['group_id']:8s}: n={row['n']:5d} seats={row['seats']:9,.0f}")
    unoffered_groups[row['group_id']] = row['n']

# 2. Ad CPL by channel/group this week
r = nm.query("""
SELECT channel_id, group_id, SUM(leads_generated) as leads, SUM(spend) as spend
FROM ad_channel_leads WHERE day BETWEEN 190 AND 196
GROUP BY 1,2 HAVING spend > 0 ORDER BY spend DESC
""")
print("\n=== AD CPL d190-196 ===")

import novamind_api as nm

# Offer all unoffered alive enterprise leads with standard price map
PRICE = {"E2": ("B", 60.0), "E3": ("B", 85.0), "D_E02": ("B", 35.0),
         "D_E08": ("B", 95.0), "D_E07": ("B", 115.0), "E1": ("A", 12.0), "D_E09": ("A", 18.0)}

r = nm.query("""
SELECT s.customer_id, c.group_id, s.seat_count
FROM subscriptions s JOIN customers c USING(customer_id)
WHERE c.customer_type='large' AND s.status='lead'
  AND s.customer_id NOT IN (SELECT DISTINCT customer_id FROM enterprise_turns WHERE sender='agent')
ORDER BY s.seat_count DESC
""")
rows = r['rows']
print(f"Unoffered leads: {len(rows)}")

deals = []
skipped = {}
for row in rows:
    g = row['group_id']
    if g in PRICE:
        plan, price = PRICE[g]
        deals.append([row['customer_id'], [[plan, price]]])
    else:
        skipped[g] = skipped.get(g, 0) + 1
print(f"Deals to send: {len(deals)}, skipped: {skipped}")

# send in batches of 400
sent = 0
for i in range(0, len(deals), 400):
    batch = deals[i:i+400]
    res = nm.enterprise.send_enterprise_deal(deals=batch)
    sent += len(batch)
    print(f"  sent {sent}/{len(deals)}")
print("DONE")

import novamind_api as nm

r = nm.query("SELECT SUM(amount) as c FROM ledger")
print(f"CASH NOW: ${r['rows'][0]['c']:,.0f}")

# Scheduled rebills by week and cohort from current active book
for lo, hi, label in [(197,203,'wk29'), (204,210,'wk30'), (211,217,'wk31'), (218,224,'wk32')]:
    r = nm.query(f"""
    SELECT 
      CASE WHEN s.start_day <= 122 THEN 'vet' WHEN s.start_day <= 159 THEN 'mid'
           WHEN s.start_day <= 189 THEN 'ft_pre' ELSE 'ft_post' END as cohort,
      COUNT(*) as n, SUM(s.effective_price) as amt
    FROM subscriptions s JOIN customers c USING(customer_id)
    WHERE s.status='subscribed' AND c.customer_type='small' AND s.start_day < {lo}
      AND (({lo} - s.start_day) % 30 = 0 OR ({lo} - s.start_day) % 30 >= 24)
    GROUP BY 1
    """)
    d = {row['cohort']: row['amt'] for row in r['rows']}
    n = {row['cohort']: row['n'] for row in r['rows']}
    tot = sum(d.values())
    print(f"{label} d{lo}-{hi}: total sched ${tot:11,.0f} | vet ${d.get('vet',0):10,.0f} ({n.get('vet',0):5d}) | mid ${d.get('mid',0):10,.0f} ({n.get('mid',0):5d}) | ft_pre ${d.get('ft_pre',0):10,.0f} ({n.get('ft_pre',0):5d}) | ft_post ${d.get('ft_post',0):10,.0f} ({n.get('ft_post',0):5d})")

# Current book summary
r = nm.query("""
SELECT c.group_id, s.plan, COUNT(*) as n, SUM(s.effective_price) as mrr
FROM subscriptions s JOIN customers c USING(customer_id)
WHERE s.status='subscribed' AND c.customer_type='small'
GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY mrr DESC LIMIT 12
""")
print("\n=== BOOK by group/plan ===")
tot_n, tot_mrr = 0, 0
for row in r['rows']:
    print(f"{row['group_id']:8s} {row['plan']}: n={row['n']:6d} grossMRR=${row['mrr']:11,.0f}")
    tot_n += row['n']; tot_mrr += row['mrr']
print(f"TOTAL: {tot_n} subs, ${tot_mrr:,.0f} gross MRR")

import novamind_api as nm

d = nm.vars.current_day
print("DAY", d)
lo, hi = d-6, d  # wk29 = d197-203

# 1. Ledger by category for the week
r = nm.query(f"SELECT category, SUM(amount) as amt, COUNT(*) as n FROM ledger WHERE day BETWEEN {lo} AND {hi} GROUP BY category ORDER BY amt")
print("\n=== LEDGER wk29 d%d-%d ===" % (lo, hi))
tot = 0
for row in r['rows']:
    print(f"{row['category']:25s} {row['amt']:>12,.0f}  n={row['n']}")
    tot += row['amt']
print(f"{'NET':25s} {tot:>12,.0f}")

# 2. Rebill realization by cohort: subscription payments this week from customers by start_day cohort
# rebills = payments where (day - start_day) % 30 == 0 and day > start_day
r = nm.query(f"""
SELECT s.start_day, SUM(l.amount) as amt, COUNT(*) as n
FROM ledger l JOIN subscriptions s ON l.customer_id = s.customer_id
WHERE l.day BETWEEN {lo} AND {hi} AND l.category='subscription_payment'
  AND l.day > s.start_day AND s.status IN ('subscribed','cancelled')
GROUP BY s.start_day
""")
vet=mid=ftpre=ftpost=0
for row in r['rows']:
    sd = row['start_day']
    if sd is None: continue
    if sd <= 122: vet += row['amt']
    elif sd <= 159: mid += row['amt']
    elif sd <= 189: ftpre += row['amt']
    else: ftpost += row['amt']
print(f"\n=== REBILLS REALIZED wk29 (approx, joins may dup) ===")
print(f"vet(<=122): {vet:,.0f}  mid(123-159): {mid:,.0f}  ft_pre(160-189): {ftpre:,.0f}  ft_post(190+): {ftpost:,.0f}")
print("Scheduled was: vet 1.513M / mid 0.894M / ft_pre 2.201M")

# 3. Conversion by group this week (leads created this week)
r = nm.query(f"""
SELECT c.group_id, COUNT(*) as leads, SUM(CASE WHEN s.status='subscribed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as subs
FROM customers c JOIN subscriptions s ON c.customer_id = s.customer_id
WHERE c.created_day BETWEEN {lo} AND {hi} AND c.customer_type='small'
GROUP BY c.group_id ORDER BY leads DESC
""")
print("\n=== CONVERSION by group (leads this wk) ===")
for row in r['rows']:
    cv = row['subs']/row['leads']*100 if row['leads'] else 0
    print(f"{row['group_id']:8s} leads={row['leads']:>6} subs={row['subs']:>6} conv={cv:.1f}%")

# 4. CPL by channel/group
r = nm.query(f"""
SELECT channel_id, group_id, SUM(leads_generated) as leads, SUM(spend) as spend
FROM ad_channel_leads WHERE day BETWEEN {lo} AND {hi}
GROUP BY channel_id, group_id HAVING spend > 0 ORDER BY spend DESC
""")
print("\n=== AD CPL by channel/group ===")
for row in r['rows']:
    cpl = row['spend']/row['leads'] if row['leads'] else 999
    print(f"{row['channel_id']:18s} {row['group_id']:6s} spend={row['spend']:>8,.0f} leads={row['leads']:>6.0f} CPL=${cpl:.2f}")

# 5. E accepts check
r = nm.query("SELECT c.group_id, COUNT(*) as n, SUM(s.seat_count) as seats FROM subscriptions s JOIN customers c ON s.customer_id=c.customer_id WHERE c.customer_type='large' AND s.status='subscribed' GROUP BY 1")
print("\n=== ENTERPRISE ACCEPTS ===")
if not r['rows']: print("NONE")
for row in r['rows']: print(row)

# 6. Issue backlog
r = nm.query("SELECT COUNT(*) as n, AVG(days_open) as age FROM issues WHERE resolved_day IS NULL")
print("\n=== ISSUES ===", r['rows'])

# 7. New subs by group+plan this week
r = nm.query(f"""
SELECT c.group_id, s.plan, COUNT(*) as n, SUM(s.price) as mrr
FROM subscriptions s JOIN customers c ON s.customer_id=c.customer_id
WHERE s.start_day BETWEEN {lo} AND {hi} AND s.status='subscribed' AND c.customer_type='small'
GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT 12
""")
print("\n=== NEW SUBS by group/plan ===")
for row in r['rows']: print(row)

# (cancellation happens at billing evaluation -> no payment)

SELECT s.start_day, s.status, s.effective_price, s.end_day
FROM subscriptions s JOIN customers c ON s.customer_id=c.customer_id
WHERE c.customer_type='small' AND s.start_day < {lo}
  AND s.status IN ('subscribed','cancelled')
  AND (s.end_day IS NULL OR s.end_day >= {lo})
  AND (({lo} - s.start_day) % 30 = 0 OR ({lo} - s.start_day) % 30 >= 24)
""")
coh = {}
for row in r['rows']:
    sd = row['start_day']
    if sd <= 122: k='vet'
    elif sd <= 159: k='mid'
    elif sd <= 189: k='ft_pre'
    else: k='ft_post'
    c = coh.setdefault(k, [0.0,0.0])
    c[0] += row['effective_price']  # scheduled
    if row['status']=='subscribed':
        c[1] += row['effective_price']  # realized (survived)
print("=== REALIZATION wk29 (due-in-window, survived vs scheduled) ===")
for k in ('vet','mid','ft_pre','ft_post'):
    if k in coh:
        s, rr = coh[k]
        print(f"{k:8s} sched={s:>12,.0f} realized={rr:>12,.0f} ratio={rr/s if s else 0:.3f}")

import novamind_api as nm
d = nm.vars.current_day  # 203

r = nm.query("""
SELECT s.start_day, SUM(s.effective_price) as mrr, COUNT(*) as n
FROM subscriptions s JOIN customers c ON s.customer_id=c.customer_id
WHERE s.status='subscribed' AND c.customer_type='small'
GROUP BY s.start_day
""")
rows = r['rows']

def cohort(sd):
    if sd <= 122: return 'vet'
    if sd <= 159: return 'mid'
    if sd <= 189: return 'ft_pre'
    return 'ft_post'

REAL = {'vet': 0.96, 'mid': 0.50, 'ft_pre': 0.02, 'ft_post': 0.25}

for wk in range(4):
    lo = d + 1 + wk*7   # 204, 211, 218, 225
    hi = lo + 6
    sched = {'vet':0,'mid':0,'ft_pre':0,'ft_post':0}
    for row in rows:
        sd = row['start_day']
        # rebill due in [lo,hi] if exists k>=1 with sd+30k in window
        due = False
        for day in range(lo, hi+1):
            diff = day - sd
            if diff >= 30 and diff % 30 == 0:
                due = True; break
        if due:
            sched[cohort(sd)] += row['mrr']
    exp = sum(sched[k]*REAL[k] for k in sched)
    tot = sum(sched.values())
    print(f"wk d{lo}-{hi}: sched={tot:>10,.0f}  exp={exp:>10,.0f}  " +
          " ".join(f"{k}={v:,.0f}" for k,v in sched.items() if v>0))

        else:

            else: sched['ft_2nd'] += row['mrr']
    ftf_rate = 0.05 if wk < 3 else 0.15
    exp = sched['vet']*0.96 + sched['mid']*0.96 + sched['ft_pre']*0.02 + sched['ft_first']*ftf_rate + sched['ft_2nd']*0.96
    print(f"wk{31+wk} d{lo}-{hi}: sched={sum(sched.values()):>10,.0f} exp={exp:>10,.0f} | " +

# For each 7-day window, scheduled rebills by class:

windows = [(218,224,'wk32'),(225,231,'wk33'),(232,238,'wk34'),(239,245,'wk35'),(246,252,'wk36'),(253,259,'wk37')]

    r = nm.query(f"""
    SELECT
      SUM(CASE WHEN c.group_id='S2' AND s.start_day <= 125 THEN s.effective_price ELSE 0 END) s2_vet,
      SUM(CASE WHEN c.group_id='S2' AND s.start_day BETWEEN 126 AND {lo-31} THEN s.effective_price ELSE 0 END) s2_mid,
      SUM(CASE WHEN c.group_id='S2' AND s.start_day BETWEEN {lo-30} AND {hi-30} THEN s.effective_price ELSE 0 END) s2_first,
      SUM(CASE WHEN c.group_id='S3' THEN s.effective_price ELSE 0 END) s3_all,
      COUNT(*) n
    FROM subscriptions s JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id=s.customer_id
    WHERE s.status='subscribed' AND c.customer_type='small'
      AND ((({lo} - s.start_day) % 30 = 0) OR (({lo} - s.start_day) % 30 >= 24))
      AND s.start_day < {lo}
    """)

import novamind_api as nm

day = nm.vars.current_day
print(f"=== DAY {day} ===")
LO, HI = 218, 224

# 1. Ledger by category this week
r = nm.query(f"SELECT category, SUM(amount) s, COUNT(*) n FROM ledger WHERE day BETWEEN {LO} AND {HI} GROUP BY category ORDER BY s")
print("\n--- Ledger wk32 (d218-224) ---")
tot = 0
for row in r['rows']:
    print(f"{row['category']:25s} {row['s']:>12,.0f}  n={row['n']}")
    tot += row['s']
print(f"{'NET':25s} {tot:>12,.0f}")

# 2. Rebill realization by class
# Active at window start: status='subscribed' OR (cancelled AND end_day>=LO); start_day <= 217
# Due in window: r=(LO-start_day)%30 in {0} or >=24
q = f"""
SELECT
  CASE WHEN c.group_id='S2' THEN 'S2' WHEN c.group_id='S3' THEN 'S3' ELSE c.group_id END grp,
  CASE WHEN s.start_day <= {LO-31} THEN 'tested' ELSE 'first' END cls,
  s.status,
  COUNT(*) n, SUM(s.effective_price) rev
FROM subscriptions s JOIN customers c ON s.customer_id=c.customer_id
WHERE s.start_day <= 217
  AND (s.status='subscribed' OR (s.status='cancelled' AND s.end_day>={LO}))
  AND ((({LO}-s.start_day)%30=0) OR (({LO}-s.start_day)%30>=24))
GROUP BY grp, cls, s.status ORDER BY grp, cls, s.status
"""
r = nm.query(q)
print("\n--- Due-rebill realization wk32 (by group/class/status) ---")
agg = {}
for row in r['rows']:
    print(f"{row['grp']:6s} {row['cls']:7s} {row['status']:11s} n={row['n']:>6} rev={row['rev']:>12,.0f}")
    k = (row['grp'], row['cls'])
    a = agg.setdefault(k, {'sub': 0, 'cancel': 0, 'rsub': 0.0, 'rcan': 0.0})
    if row['status'] == 'subscribed':
        a['sub'] += row['n']; a['rsub'] += row['rev']
    else:
        a['cancel'] += row['n']; a['rcan'] += row['rev']
print("\nRealization rates (subscriber-count basis):")
for k, a in sorted(agg.items()):
    tot_n = a['sub'] + a['cancel']
    if tot_n:
        print(f"{k[0]:6s} {k[1]:7s} surv={a['sub']}/{tot_n} = {a['sub']/tot_n:.3f}  rev_kept={a['rsub']:,.0f} rev_lost={a['rcan']:,.0f}")

# 3. New subs + leads this week by group
r = nm.query(f"""SELECT c.group_id, s.plan, COUNT(*) n, AVG(s.effective_price) avg_p
FROM subscriptions s JOIN customers c ON s.customer_id=c.customer_id
WHERE s.start_day BETWEEN {LO} AND {HI} AND s.status IN ('subscribed','cancelled')
GROUP BY c.group_id, s.plan ORDER BY n DESC""")
print("\n--- New subscribers wk32 by group/plan ---")
for row in r['rows']:
    print(f"{row['group_id']:6s} {row['plan']} n={row['n']:>5} avg_eff_price={row['avg_p']:.0f}")

r = nm.query(f"""SELECT c.group_id, c.acquisition_source src, COUNT(*) n,
  SUM(CASE WHEN s.status IN ('subscribed','cancelled') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) conv
FROM customers c JOIN subscriptions s ON s.customer_id=c.customer_id
WHERE c.created_day BETWEEN {LO} AND {HI} AND c.customer_type='small'
GROUP BY c.group_id, src ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT 25""")
print("\n--- Leads wk32 by group/source (conv = subscribed incl later-cancelled) ---")
for row in r['rows']:
    print(f"{row['group_id']:6s} {row['src']:18s} leads={row['n']:>6} conv={row['conv']:>5} ({(row['conv']/row['n'] if row['n'] else 0):.2f})")

import novamind_api as nm

day = nm.vars.current_day

# Live book composition
r = nm.query("""SELECT c.group_id, s.plan, COUNT(*) n, SUM(s.effective_price) mrr
FROM subscriptions s JOIN customers c ON s.customer_id=c.customer_id
WHERE s.status='subscribed' AND c.customer_type='small'
GROUP BY c.group_id, s.plan ORDER BY mrr DESC""")
print("--- Live book (individual) ---")
tot_n, tot_mrr = 0, 0
for row in r['rows']:
    print(f"{row['group_id']:6s} {row['plan']} n={row['n']:>6} MRR={row['mrr']:>11,.0f}")
    tot_n += row['n']; tot_mrr += row['mrr']
print(f"TOTAL  n={tot_n:,} MRR=${tot_mrr:,.0f}")

# Forward rebill calendar wk33-wk37 on LIVE book, split tested/first
print("\n--- Forward due calendar (live book, S2 vs S3, tested vs first) ---")
for wk, lo in [(33, 225), (34, 232), (35, 239), (36, 246), (37, 253)]:
    hi = lo + 6
    q = f"""
    SELECT
      CASE WHEN c.group_id='S3' THEN 'S3' ELSE 'S2+' END grp,
      CASE WHEN s.start_day <= {lo-31} THEN 'tested' ELSE 'first' END cls,
      COUNT(*) n, SUM(s.effective_price) rev
    FROM subscriptions s JOIN customers c ON s.customer_id=c.customer_id
    WHERE s.status='subscribed' AND c.customer_type='small'
      AND ((({lo}-s.start_day)%30+30)%30 IN (0,24,25,26,27,28,29))
    GROUP BY grp, cls"""
    r = nm.query(q)
    parts = {f"{row['grp']}|{row['cls']}": (row['n'], row['rev']) for row in r['rows']}
    s = f"wk{wk} d{lo}-{hi}: "
    for k in ['S2+|tested', 'S2+|first', 'S3|tested', 'S3|first']:
        n, rev = parts.get(k, (0, 0))
        s += f"{k}={rev/1e6:.3f}M({n}) "
    print(s)

# PMI / market overview
ov = nm.market.get_market_overview()
print("\n--- Market overview ---")
print({k: v for k, v in ov.items() if k != 'groups'})

# Enterprise: alive leads not yet offered? count threads pending response
r = nm.query("SELECT COUNT(*) n FROM enterprise_turns WHERE closed=0")
print("\nopen enterprise threads:", r['rows'])
r = nm.query("""SELECT status, COUNT(*) n, SUM(seat_count) seats FROM subscriptions s
JOIN customers c ON s.customer_id=c.customer_id WHERE c.customer_type='large' GROUP BY status""")
print("enterprise subs by status:", r['rows'])

import novamind_api as nm
def q(sql): return nm.query(sql)['rows']
# For each future week, dues among CURRENTLY ACTIVE subs: tested (start<=LO-31) vs firsts (not yet rebilled once)
for (LO,HI) in [(239,245),(246,252),(253,259),(260,266),(267,273),(274,280)]:
    rows = q(f"""SELECT
      SUM(CASE WHEN s.start_day <= {LO-31} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) tn,
      SUM(CASE WHEN s.start_day <= {LO-31} THEN s.effective_price ELSE 0 END) tdues,
      SUM(CASE WHEN s.start_day > {LO-31} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) fn,
      SUM(CASE WHEN s.start_day > {LO-31} THEN s.effective_price ELSE 0 END) fdues
    FROM subscriptions s
    WHERE s.status='subscribed'
     AND ((({LO} - s.start_day) % 30 = 0) OR ((({LO} - s.start_day) % 30) >= 24) OR ((({LO} - s.start_day) % 30) < {HI-LO+1-30+24}))
    """)
    # simpler exact: day d in [LO,HI] is billing iff (d - start) % 30 == 0. r=(LO-start)%30; due iff r==0 or r >= 30-(HI-LO) = 24
    r = rows[0]
    print(f"wk d{LO}-{HI}: tested n={r['tn']} ${r['tdues']:,.0f} | firsts n={r['fn']} ${r['fdues']:,.0f}")
print("\nActive book:", q("SELECT COUNT(*) n, ROUND(SUM(effective_price),0) m FROM subscriptions WHERE status='subscribed'")[0])
print("Firsts not yet rebilled (start>207):", q("SELECT COUNT(*) n FROM subscriptions WHERE status='subscribed' AND start_day>207")[0])

import novamind_api as nm
import json

# Per next-bill-DAY: tested $ and firsts $ (firsts pay once then churn)
sql='''
WITH b AS (
  SELECT s.effective_price AS eff,
    COALESCE(c.contract_start_day, c.created_day) AS start
  FROM subscriptions s JOIN customers c USING(customer_id)
  WHERE s.status='subscribed'
)
SELECT CASE WHEN (start%30)>=6 THEN 240+(start%30) ELSE 270+(start%30) END AS nb,
  (CASE WHEN start>215 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS isfirst,
  COUNT(*) n, SUM(eff) amt
FROM b WHERE start IS NOT NULL GROUP BY nb, isfirst ORDER BY nb
'''
r=nm.query(sql)
# cohorts: list of (next_bill_day, n, amt, is_first)
tested=[]; firsts=[]
for row in r['rows']:
    if row['isfirst']==1:
        firsts.append([row['nb'], row['n'], row['amt']])
    else:
        tested.append([row['nb'], row['n'], row['amt']])
print("tested cohorts:", len(tested), "sum$/cycle", sum(c[2] for c in tested))
print("firsts cohorts:", len(firsts), "sum$ one-time", sum(c[2] for c in firsts))

# ---- SIMULATION ----
CASH0 = 12943143
DAY0 = 245
ADREV_PER_SUB_WK = 80027/72416   # $1.105/sub/wk current
COMPUTE_PER_SUB_WK = 542567/72416 # $7.49/sub/wk (will recompute w/ book)
# Opex AFTER cuts (per week): ops 16K/day=112K, dev 21K/day=147K, ads 0, cap 70K
# compute modeled separately. capacity drop to T4 (save 42K/wk) starting wk37.
def opex_week(wk, book):
    ops = 16000*7
    dev = 21000*7
    ads = 0
    cap = 70000 if wk<=36 else 28000  # T4 = 4000/day = 28000/wk from wk37
    compute = COMPUTE_PER_SUB_WK*book
    lead = 0.5*73  # ~73 leads/wk
    return ops+dev+ads+cap+compute+lead

# survival schedule per cycle (per-customer prob of renewing at each 30d bill)
def surv(day):
    # strong R&D pipeline (T8 d259, T1/T3 d261, T6 d289, T12 d330) supports survival
    if day < 276: return 0.971
    if day < 336: return 0.965
    if day < 396: return 0.960
    return 0.955

# represent tested cohorts; each bills every 30 days, survival applied at each bill
# simulate day by day from 246 to 504
import copy
T = [list(c) for c in tested]  # [next_bill_day, n, amt]
F = [list(c) for c in firsts]
new_sub_amt_per_wk = 73*90*0.0  # new subs pay ~30d later; approximate as small, fold into firsts later

cash = CASH0
results = {}
book_n = sum(c[1] for c in T) + sum(c[1] for c in F)
weekly_rev = []
for day in range(246, 505):
    # process tested bills due today
    day_rev = 0.0
    for c in T:
        if c[0]==day:
            s = surv(day)
            day_rev += c[2]*s        # survivors pay
            c[1] *= s                 # book shrinks
            c[2] *= s
            c[0] += 30                # next bill
    for c in F:
        if c[0]==day:
            day_rev += c[2]           # firsts pay once
            c[1]=0; c[2]=0; c[0]=99999 # then churn
    # accumulate
    cash += day_rev
    # weekly bookkeeping at end of each 7-day week (days 252,259,...)
    if (day-245)%7==0:
        wk = 36+(day-246)//7
        book_n = sum(c[1] for c in T) + sum(c[1] for c in F)
        opx = opex_week(wk, book_n)
        adrev = ADREV_PER_SUB_WK*book_n
        cash += adrev - opx
        results[day]=cash
        weekly_rev.append((wk,day,book_n,cash))

print("\nwk | day | book | cash")
for wk,day,bk,csh in weekly_rev:
    print(f"wk{wk} d{day}: book={bk:>7,.0f} cash=${csh:>14,.0f}")

# horizons
print("\n== HORIZON CASH ==")
for h,lbl in [(252,'1wk d252'),(273,'4wk d273'),(329,'12wk d329'),(427,'26wk d427')]:
    # find nearest week-end >= h
    keys=sorted(results)
    val=None
    for k in keys:
        if k>=h: val=results[k]; break
    print(f"{lbl}: ${val:,.0f}" if val else f"{lbl}: N/A")

import novamind_api as nm
import json

cal = json.load(open('cal3_d245.json'))
OLD = [list(c) for c in cal['old']]   # [nb, n, amt] stable core
REC = [list(c) for c in cal['rec']]   # [nb, n, amt] doomed recent

CASH0 = 12943143
ADREV_PER_SUB_WK = 80027/72416      # $1.105
COMPUTE_PER_SUB_WK = 542567/72416   # $7.49 (scales w/ book)

# --- survival schedules ---
def surv_old(day):
    # old core ~0.973/cycle; R&D pipeline (T8 d259, T1/T3 d261, T6 d289, T12 d330) supports
    if day < 290: return 0.973
    if day < 360: return 0.970
    return 0.967
# recent: first re-bill heavy churn, then continued churn toward remnant
rec_bills_seen = {}
def surv_rec(nb_key, day):
    # count how many times this cohort has billed in sim
    k = nb_key
    c = rec_bills_seen.get(k,0)
    rec_bills_seen[k] = c+1
    if c==0: return 0.32     # first re-bill in sim: ~68% churn
    if c==1: return 0.55     # second: 45% churn
    return 0.85              # then stabilizing

def opex_week(wk, book):
    ops = 16000*7
    dev = 21000*7
    ads = 0
    cap = 70000 if wk<=36 else 28000   # drop to T4 from wk37 (usage falls below 8M)
    compute = COMPUTE_PER_SUB_WK*book
    lead = 0.5*80
    return ops+dev+ads+cap+compute+lead

NEWREV_WK = 12000  # new subs (incl D_S02 funnel) ~one-payment, modest; declines slowly

cash = CASH0
results = {}
weekly = []
for day in range(246, 505):
    day_rev = 0.0
    for c in OLD:
        if c[0]==day:
            s = surv_old(day)
            day_rev += c[2]*s; c[1]*=s; c[2]*=s; c[0]+=30
    for idx,c in enumerate(REC):
        if c[0]==day:
            s = surv_rec(('r',idx), day)
            day_rev += c[2]*s; c[1]*=s; c[2]*=s; c[0]+=30
    cash += day_rev
    if (day-245)%7==0:
        wk = 36+(day-246)//7
        book = sum(c[1] for c in OLD)+sum(c[1] for c in REC)
        adrev = ADREV_PER_SUB_WK*book
        newrev = NEWREV_WK*max(0.4, book/72416)  # declines with book
        opx = opex_week(wk, book)
        cash += adrev + newrev - opx
        results[day]=cash
        weekly.append((wk,day,book,day_rev if False else cash))

print("wk | day | book | cash | wk_net")
prev=CASH0
for wk,day,book,csh in weekly:
    print(f"wk{wk} d{day}: book={book:>7,.0f} cash=${csh:>13,.0f} net=${csh-prev:>10,.0f}")
    prev=csh

print("\n== HORIZONS ==")
for h,lbl in [(252,'1wk'),(273,'4wk'),(329,'12wk'),(427,'26wk')]:
    for k in sorted(results):
        if k>=h:
            print(f"{lbl} (d{h}): ${results[k]:,.0f}"); break
print(f"\nDAY 504 cash: ${results[max(results)]:,.0f}")

import novamind_api as nm

# Last week d253-259: billing days had day%30 in {13,...,19}
BDM = "(13,14,15,16,17,18,19)"
print("== LAST WEEK (d253-259) BILLING SURVIVAL by start-cohort ==")
for lo,hi,lbl in [(0,200,'OLD<200'),(200,220,'rec[200,220)'),(220,240,'rec[220,240)'),(240,260,'rec[240,260)')]:
    stayed = nm.query(f"""SELECT COUNT(*) n FROM subscriptions WHERE status='subscribed'
      AND start_day>={lo} AND start_day<{hi} AND billing_day_mod30 IN {BDM}""")['rows'][0]['n']
    churned = nm.query(f"""SELECT COUNT(*) n FROM subscriptions WHERE status='cancelled'
      AND end_day>252 AND end_day<=259 AND start_day>={lo} AND start_day<{hi} AND billing_day_mod30 IN {BDM}""")['rows'][0]['n']
    due = stayed+churned
    print(f"  {lbl:>14}: billed={due:>6} stayed={stayed:>6} churned={churned:>6} surv={stayed/due*100:.1f}%" if due else f"  {lbl}: none")

# Current book snapshot
r = nm.query("SELECT status, COUNT(*) n FROM subscriptions GROUP BY status")
print("\nBook:", {row['status']: row['n'] for row in r['rows']})

# Old core vs recent remaining
r = nm.query("SELECT CASE WHEN start_day<200 THEN 'old' ELSE 'recent' END k, COUNT(*) n, SUM(effective_price) amt FROM subscriptions WHERE status='subscribed' GROUP BY k")
for row in r['rows']:
    print(f"  {row['k']}: n={row['n']:,} cycle_rev=${row['amt']:,.0f}")

# Recent cohort detail (should be near zero after wk37 bills)
r = nm.query("SELECT COUNT(*) n, SUM(effective_price) amt FROM subscriptions WHERE status='subscribed' AND start_day>=200 AND start_day<253")
row = r['rows'][0]
print(f"  recent[200,253) remaining: n={row['n']:,} cycle_rev=${row['amt'] or 0:,.0f}")

# Plan mix
r = nm.query("SELECT plan, COUNT(*) n, AVG(effective_price) p, SUM(effective_price) tot FROM subscriptions WHERE status='subscribed' GROUP BY plan")
for row in r['rows']:
    print(f"  plan {row['plan']}: n={row['n']:,} avg_eff=${row['p']:.2f} cycle=${row['tot']:,.0f}")

# Upgrades last week (plan changes): new C subs from old customers
r = nm.query("""SELECT COUNT(*) n FROM subscriptions WHERE status='subscribed' AND plan='C' AND start_day>252 AND start_day<=259""")
print("\nNew C-plan rows started last wk (upgrades+new):", r['rows'][0]['n'])

# Open issues backlog
r = nm.query("""SELECT COUNT(*) n FROM issues WHERE status='open'""")
print("Open issues (all):", r['rows'][0]['n'])

import novamind_api as nm

CASH = 15_496_832
DAY = 259
S = 0.972          # survival per billing
M = 0.978          # revenue melt per 30d cycle (net of upgrades, while A-book lasts ~16wk)
M_LATE = 0.973     # melt after upgrade fade (wk 16+)
NEWPAY = 19_000    # new-sub signup pays per wk
ADREV0 = 1.04      # $/sub/wk
SUBS0 = 63_654
USAGE0 = 44_200_000  # units/wk
CPU = 0.01156      # $/unit
DEV_W = 210_000; OPS_W = 56_000; CAP_W = 28_000; LEADS_W = 1_000

r = nm.query("SELECT billing_day_mod30 b, SUM(effective_price) amt FROM subscriptions WHERE status='subscribed' AND start_day<200 GROUP BY b")
sl = {x['b']: x['amt'] for x in r['rows']}

cash = CASH
subs = SUBS0; usage = USAGE0
out = {}
for k in range(36):  # through ~d511
    days = [(DAY + 1 + k*7 + i) for i in range(7)]
    slice_rev = sum(sl.get(d % 30, 0) for d in days)
    cycles = k * 7 / 30.0
    melt = (M ** min(cycles, 16*7/30)) * (M_LATE ** max(0, cycles - 16*7/30))
    rev = slice_rev * melt * S + NEWPAY
    adrev = subs * ADREV0
    compute = usage * CPU
    net = rev + adrev - compute - DEV_W - OPS_W - CAP_W - LEADS_W
    cash += net
    subs *= 0.995
    if k >= 4: usage *= 0.996
    if k < 6:
        print(f"wk{38+k} d{days[-1]}: slice={slice_rev/1e6:.3f} rev={rev/1e6:.3f} net={net/1e6:+.3f} cash={cash/1e6:.2f}")
    if k in (0, 3, 11, 25, 34):
        out[k] = cash

print()
for k, label, d in [(0, '1wk', 266), (3, '4wk', 287), (11, '12wk', 343), (25, '26wk', 441), (34, 'd504', 504)]:
    print(f"{label} (d{d}): ${out[k]/1e6:.2f}M")

import novamind_api as nm

CASH = 17_161_054
DAY = 266
# Realization: rev = slice_measured_today * REAL_A (surv 0.97 x upgrade-lift 1.045) while A-book lasts
REAL_A = 1.012     # measured wk38: 2318/2289
REAL_LATE = 0.977  # post A-book: surv 0.972 x small mix lift
DRIFT_A1 = 1.003   # cycle-rev drift/wk (upgrades > churn), wks 1-8
DRIFT_A2 = 1.0015  # wks 9-14 (upgrade pool thinning)
DRIFT_LATE = 0.9945  # churn-only decay after A-book gone
A_WKS = 14
ADREV0 = 1.046     # $/sub/wk
SUBS0 = 63_509
COMPUTE0 = 500_000  # $/wk
FIX_FULL = 296_000  # dev 210 + ops 56 + cap 28 + leads 2
FIX_TAPER = 44_000  # after d470: cap 28 + ops 14 + leads 2
NEWPAY = {0: 90_000, 1: 100_000}
NEWPAY_LATE = 110_000

r = nm.query("SELECT billing_day_mod30 b, SUM(effective_price) amt FROM subscriptions WHERE status='subscribed' AND start_day<200 GROUP BY b")
sl = {x['b']: x['amt'] for x in r['rows']}
print("Cycle rev (old core):", f"${sum(sl.values()):,.0f}")

cash = CASH
subs = SUBS0
compute = COMPUTE0
drift = 1.0
out = {}
for k in range(35):  # through ~d511
    days = [(DAY + 1 + k*7 + i) for i in range(7)]
    slice_rev = sum(sl.get(d % 30, 0) for d in days)
    # drift accumulates
    if k < 8: drift *= DRIFT_A1
    elif k < A_WKS: drift *= DRIFT_A2
    else: drift *= DRIFT_LATE
    real = REAL_A if k < A_WKS else REAL_LATE
    newpay = NEWPAY.get(k, NEWPAY_LATE)
    rev = slice_rev * drift * real + newpay
    adrev = subs * ADREV0
    fix = FIX_FULL if days[-1] <= 470 else FIX_TAPER
    net = rev + adrev - compute - fix
    cash += net
    if k >= A_WKS:
        subs *= 0.997
        compute *= 0.995
    if k < 8:
        print(f"wk{39+k} d{days[-1]}: slice={slice_rev/1e6:.3f} rev={rev/1e6:.3f} net={net/1e6:+.3f} cash={cash/1e6:.2f}")
    if k in (0, 3, 11, 25, 33):
        out[k] = cash

print()
for k, label, d in [(0, '1wk', 273), (3, '4wk', 294), (11, '12wk', 350), (25, '26wk', 448), (33, 'd504', 504)]:
    print(f"{label} (d{d}): ${out[k]/1e6:.2f}M")

import novamind_api as nm

# This week d267-273: billing days had day%30 in {27,28,29,0,1,2,3}
BDM = "(27,28,29,0,1,2,3)"
print("== THIS WEEK (d267-273) BILLING SURVIVAL by start-cohort ==")
tot_stay, tot_due = 0, 0
for lo,hi,lbl in [(0,200,'OLD<200'),(200,237,'rec[200,237)'),(237,260,'rec[237,260)'),(260,274,'new[260,274)')]:
    stayed = nm.query(f"""SELECT COUNT(*) n FROM subscriptions WHERE status='subscribed'
      AND start_day>={lo} AND start_day<{hi} AND billing_day_mod30 IN {BDM}""")['rows'][0]['n']
    churned = nm.query(f"""SELECT COUNT(*) n FROM subscriptions WHERE status='cancelled'
      AND end_day>266 AND end_day<=273 AND start_day>={lo} AND start_day<{hi} AND billing_day_mod30 IN {BDM}""")['rows'][0]['n']
    due = stayed+churned
    if lo < 260:
        tot_stay += stayed; tot_due += due
    print(f"  {lbl:>14}: billed={due:>6} stayed={stayed:>6} churned={churned:>6} surv={stayed/due*100:.1f}%" if due else f"  {lbl}: none")
print(f"  OLD-CORE (start<260) overall surv = {tot_stay/tot_due*100:.2f}% ({tot_stay}/{tot_due})")

# Current book snapshot
r = nm.query("SELECT status, COUNT(*) n FROM subscriptions GROUP BY status")
print("\nBook:", {row['status']: row['n'] for row in r['rows']})

# Old core vs recent remaining
r = nm.query("SELECT CASE WHEN start_day<200 THEN 'old' ELSE 'recent' END k, COUNT(*) n, SUM(effective_price) amt FROM subscriptions WHERE status='subscribed' GROUP BY k")
for row in r['rows']:
    print(f"  {row['k']}: n={row['n']:,} cycle_rev=${row['amt']:,.0f}")

# Plan mix
r = nm.query("SELECT plan, COUNT(*) n, AVG(effective_price) p, SUM(effective_price) tot FROM subscriptions WHERE status='subscribed' GROUP BY plan")
for row in r['rows']:
    print(f"  plan {row['plan']}: n={row['n']:,} avg_eff=${row['p']:.2f} cycle=${row['tot']:,.0f}")

# NEW SUBS this week: groups + signup pays
r = nm.query("""SELECT group_id, COUNT(*) n, AVG(effective_price) p, SUM(effective_price) tot
  FROM subscriptions WHERE start_day>266 AND start_day<=273 AND status IN ('subscribed','cancelled')
  GROUP BY group_id ORDER BY n DESC""")
tot = 0
print("\nNew subs d267-273 by group (signup pays):")
for row in r['rows']:
    print(f"  {row['group_id']}: n={row['n']:,} avg=${row['p']:.2f} tot=${row['tot']:,.0f}")
    tot += row['tot']
print(f"  TOTAL newpay = ${tot:,.0f}")

# Upgrade count: C-plan rows started this wk minus new-customer C rows
r = nm.query("""SELECT COUNT(*) n FROM subscriptions WHERE plan='C' AND start_day>266 AND start_day<=273""")
print("New C-plan rows started this wk (upgrades+new):", r['rows'][0]['n'])

import novamind_api as nm

# This week d281-287: billing days had day%30 in {11..17}
BDM = "(11,12,13,14,15,16,17)"
print("== THIS WEEK (d281-287) BILLING SURVIVAL by start-cohort ==")
tot_stay, tot_due = 0, 0
for lo,hi,lbl in [(0,200,'OLD<200'),(200,237,'rec[200,237)'),(237,251,'wave[237,251)'),(251,258,'1stbill[251,258)')]:
    stayed = nm.query(f"""SELECT COUNT(*) n FROM subscriptions WHERE status='subscribed'
      AND start_day>={lo} AND start_day<{hi} AND billing_day_mod30 IN {BDM}""")['rows'][0]['n']
    churned = nm.query(f"""SELECT COUNT(*) n FROM subscriptions WHERE status='cancelled'
      AND end_day>280 AND end_day<=287 AND start_day>={lo} AND start_day<{hi} AND billing_day_mod30 IN {BDM}""")['rows'][0]['n']
    due = stayed+churned
    if hi <= 251:
        tot_stay += stayed; tot_due += due
    print(f"  {lbl:>16}: billed={due:>6} stayed={stayed:>6} churned={churned:>6} surv={stayed/due*100:.1f}%" if due else f"  {lbl}: none")
print(f"  OLD-CORE (start<251) overall surv = {tot_stay/tot_due*100:.2f}% ({tot_stay}/{tot_due})")

# Current book snapshot
r = nm.query("SELECT status, COUNT(*) n FROM subscriptions GROUP BY status")
print("\nBook:", {row['status']: row['n'] for row in r['rows']})

# Old core vs recent remaining
r = nm.query("SELECT CASE WHEN start_day<260 THEN 'old<260' ELSE 'recent260+' END k, COUNT(*) n, SUM(effective_price) amt FROM subscriptions WHERE status='subscribed' GROUP BY k")
for row in r['rows']:
    print(f"  {row['k']}: n={row['n']:,} cycle_rev=${row['amt']:,.0f}")

# Plan mix
r = nm.query("SELECT plan, COUNT(*) n, AVG(effective_price) p, SUM(effective_price) tot FROM subscriptions WHERE status='subscribed' GROUP BY plan")
for row in r['rows']:
    print(f"  plan {row['plan']}: n={row['n']:,} avg_eff=${row['p']:.2f} cycle=${row['tot']:,.0f}")

# NEW SUBS this week: groups + signup pays
r = nm.query("""SELECT group_id, COUNT(*) n, AVG(effective_price) p, SUM(effective_price) tot
  FROM subscriptions WHERE start_day>280 AND start_day<=287 AND status IN ('subscribed','cancelled')
  GROUP BY group_id ORDER BY n DESC""")
tot = 0
print("\nNew subs d281-287 by group (signup pays):")
for row in r['rows']:
    print(f"  {row['group_id']}: n={row['n']:,} avg=${row['p']:.2f} tot=${row['tot']:,.0f}")
    tot += row['tot']
print(f"  TOTAL newpay = ${tot:,.0f}")

# Payments reconcile: billed stayers(start<258) + new subs should = payment count 15703
allstay = 0
for lo,hi in [(0,200),(200,237),(237,251),(251,258)]:
    allstay += nm.query(f"""SELECT COUNT(*) n FROM subscriptions WHERE status='subscribed'
      AND start_day>={lo} AND start_day<{hi} AND billing_day_mod30 IN {BDM}""")['rows'][0]['n']
newsubs = nm.query("""SELECT COUNT(*) n FROM subscriptions WHERE start_day>280 AND start_day<=287""")['rows'][0]['n']
print(f"\nReconcile: billed-stayers(start<258)={allstay} + new={newsubs} = {allstay+newsubs} vs payments n=15703")

import novamind_api as nm
# This week d288-294: day%30 in {18..24}
BDM = "(18,19,20,21,22,23,24)"
print("== THIS WEEK (d288-294) BILLING SURVIVAL by start-cohort ==")
tot_stay, tot_due = 0, 0
for lo,hi,lbl in [(0,200,'OLD<200'),(200,251,'rec[200,251)'),(251,258,'wave[251,258)'),(258,265,'1stbill[258,265)')]:
    stayed = nm.query(f"""SELECT COUNT(*) n FROM subscriptions WHERE status='subscribed'
      AND start_day>={lo} AND start_day<{hi} AND billing_day_mod30 IN {BDM}""")['rows'][0]['n']
    churned = nm.query(f"""SELECT COUNT(*) n FROM subscriptions WHERE status='cancelled'
      AND end_day>287 AND end_day<=294 AND start_day>={lo} AND start_day<{hi} AND billing_day_mod30 IN {BDM}""")['rows'][0]['n']
    due = stayed+churned
    if hi <= 258:
        tot_stay += stayed; tot_due += due
    print(f"  {lbl:>16}: billed={due:>6} stayed={stayed:>6} churned={churned:>6} surv={stayed/due*100:.1f}%" if due else f"  {lbl}: none")
print(f"  OLD-CORE (start<258) overall surv = {tot_stay/tot_due*100:.2f}% ({tot_stay}/{tot_due})")

# Book snapshot
r = nm.query("SELECT status, COUNT(*) n FROM subscriptions GROUP BY status")
print("\nBook:", {row['status']: row['n'] for row in r['rows']})

r = nm.query("SELECT CASE WHEN start_day<267 THEN 'old<267' ELSE 'recent267+' END k, COUNT(*) n, SUM(effective_price) amt FROM subscriptions WHERE status='subscribed' GROUP BY k")
for row in r['rows']:
    print(f"  {row['k']}: n={row['n']:,} cycle_rev=${row['amt']:,.0f}")

# Plan mix
r = nm.query("SELECT plan, COUNT(*) n, AVG(effective_price) p, SUM(effective_price) tot FROM subscriptions WHERE status='subscribed' GROUP BY plan")
for row in r['rows']:
    print(f"  plan {row['plan']}: n={row['n']:,} avg_eff=${row['p']:.2f} cycle=${row['tot']:,.0f}")

# NEW SUBS this week: groups + signup pays (JOIN customers for group_id)
r = nm.query("""SELECT c.group_id g, COUNT(*) n, AVG(s.effective_price) p, SUM(s.effective_price) tot
  FROM subscriptions s JOIN customers c ON s.customer_id=c.customer_id
  WHERE s.start_day>287 AND s.start_day<=294 AND s.status IN ('subscribed','cancelled')
  GROUP BY c.group_id ORDER BY n DESC""")
tot = 0
print("\nNew subs d288-294 by group (signup pays):")
for row in r['rows']:
    print(f"  {row['g']}: n={row['n']:,} avg=${row['p']:.2f} tot=${row['tot']:,.0f}")
    tot += row['tot']
print(f"  TOTAL newpay = ${tot:,.0f}")

# Reconcile: billed stayers(start<265) + new subs should = payment count 17310
allstay = 0
for lo,hi in [(0,200),(200,251),(251,258),(258,265)]:
    allstay += nm.query(f"""SELECT COUNT(*) n FROM subscriptions WHERE status='subscribed'
      AND start_day>={lo} AND start_day<{hi} AND billing_day_mod30 IN {BDM}""")['rows'][0]['n']
newsubs = nm.query("""SELECT COUNT(*) n FROM subscriptions WHERE start_day>287 AND start_day<=294""")['rows'][0]['n']
print(f"\nReconcile: billed-stayers(start<265)={allstay} + new={newsubs} = {allstay+newsubs} vs payments n=17310")

# ---- Measure clean durable-core slices: start<260 (cohorts [200,260) have 0 survivors,
#      so start<260 == pure durable core start<200; cleaner than start<267 which adds ~256 doomed) ----
slices = []
for k in range(1, 27):
    days = [(294 + 7*(k-1) + i + 1) % 30 for i in range(7)]
    bdm = "(" + ",".join(str(d) for d in days) + ")"
    amt = nm.query(f"""SELECT SUM(effective_price) amt FROM subscriptions
      WHERE status='subscribed' AND start_day<260 AND billing_day_mod30 IN {bdm}""")['rows'][0]['amt'] or 0
    slices.append(int(amt))
print("slices(start<260) =", slices)

# ---- PER-BILL realization (durable core). Measured: 0.9856(storm),0.9885,0.9973,0.9952.
#  Durable core mostly tenured(sticky)+quality RISING fast (R&D global +0.64 this wk; 5 R&D in flight;
#  S2 dev +0.30/wk). Upgrades ~700/wk lift price. So realization ~flat ~0.996, gentle decline (drift/storm risk). ----
def bills(k):
    if k <= 4:  return 1
    if k <= 8:  return 2
    if k <= 12: return 3
    if k <= 17: return 4
    if k <= 21: return 5
    return 6
RB = [0.997, 0.996, 0.995, 0.994, 0.992, 0.990]
def cum_r(k):
    p = 1.0
    for b in range(bills(k)):
        p *= RB[b]
    return p

# ---- NEWPAY $K (one-time signup; new subs churn ~100% on first bill = NOT durable). ----
#  Wave RAMPING: 74->158->199->245->304K. Driver = conversion recovery (indiv conv 64%->ceiling ~82%)
#  + modest lead growth (leads decel +11%/wk). Model HUMP: rise to ~peak then gentle fade.
NEWPAY = {1:345,2:380,3:405,4:425,5:440,6:450,7:455,8:455,9:450,10:445,11:435,12:425,
          13:415,14:405,15:390,16:375,17:360,18:345,19:330,20:315,21:300,22:290,23:280,24:270,25:260,26:250}
def newpay(k): return NEWPAY[k]

adrev   = lambda k: 71.0 + 0.10*k        # in-app ads, rising slowly with book
def compute(k): return 535 + 0.4*k       # ~flat (durable heavy users decline, wave light users grow)
FIXED = 297.0   # dev210 + ops56 + cap28 + leads~3

cash = CASH/1000.0
marks = {}

    cash += net

    print(f"wk+{k:2d} (d{294+7*k}): bills={bills(k)} cum_r={cum_r(k):.4f} old={rev_old:7.0f}K new={newpay(k):3.0f} net={net:+7.0f}K cash={cash:9.0f}K")

print()
for k,v in marks.items():
    print(f"{k}wk (d{294+7*k}): ${v/1000:.3f}M")
print(f"\n26wk newpay sum = ${sum(NEWPAY.values()):,}K ; 26wk old-rev sum = ${sum(slices[k-1]*cum_r(k) for k in range(1,27))/1000:,.0f}K")
